title: audit detail audit.repeat
description: detail of audit rows with action audit.repeat: further reads, or further rows of the request pipeline (request.write, request.refused), with the same key (action, result, actor, agent, device, scope IDs, target, query) within one window of window_s seconds after the first, which is the row first_seq (ADR-063 section 3). Metadata only (02-data-model.md section 2.9); every value is flat (string of printable ASCII up to 256 characters, integer, boolean or null) like the generic detail of api/org-audit.response.json.
